title: R2 fixes: key zeroing and memory safety
description:
Fix three key-zeroing defects found in review round 2:
1. ECC public key stack buffer (raw[]) not zeroed after wc_ecc_export_x963 in WC_SETKEY_ECC_PUB path
2. XMEMSET used instead of ForceZero on init_op structs containing key material in crypto2dev_cipher() and crypto2dev_hmac()
3. HMAC accumulation buffer ctx->data freed without zeroing first in Update path
All in crypto2dev_port.c.
